'''Camaille Nolaisen''' is one of the lordlings in [[Cairhien]] who try taking up being [[Aiel]].

== Appearance ==
She is pale skinned. She is 5'2 tall, with dark eyes, and dark hair worn in a long mannish cut and tied at the nape of her neck with a dark ribbon. She is one of those among Cha Faile who keeps feminine touches in her clothing.

==History==
Her brother is [[Barmanes Nolaisen]].

== Activities ==
She meets [[Rand al'Thor]] when he arrives back in Cairhien and leads him to the Throne Room where [[Colavaere Saighan]] had just recently crowned herself.
[[Faile Bashere]] takes Camaille and the rest of her society into her service, where she becomes a member of [[Cha Faile]]. Camaille then Travels to [[Ghealdan]] with Faile and [[Perrin Aybara]] and his army to track down [[Masema Dagar]].

Faile considers Camaille and [[Arrela Shiego|Arrela]] as having the quickest minds among Cha Faile, although [[Selande Darengil|Selande]] and [[Parelean]] are smarter.

She accompanies Perrin to the town of [[Almizar]]. While there she joins some [[Seanchan]] in dice and attempts to find out any news or rumors during the process.

After the [[Battle of Malden]] she goes with the scouts into Cairhien to look for [[Rand al'Thor]].
